m: स्वैर mf(आ)n. (prob. fr. स्व + ईर, ‘going, moving’) going where one likes, doing what one likes, self-willed, wilful, independent, unrestrained, L.
walking slowly or cautiously, Kāv.
voluntary, optional, MW.
स्वैर (अम्), n. wilfulness, ib.
स्वैर &c. See p. 1279, col. 1.
a: स्वैर — a. [स्वस्य ईरम् ईर्-अच् वृद्धिः] 1 Following one's own will or fancy, self-willed, wanton, uncontrolled, unrestrained; बद्धमिव स्वैरगतिर्जनमिह सुखसंगिनमवैमि Ś. 5. 11; अव्याहतैः स्वैरगतैः स तस्याः R. 2. 5. --2 Free, unreserved, confidential; as in स्वैरालाप Mu. 4. 8. --3 Slow, mild, gentle; Mu. 1. 2. --4 Dull, lazy. --5 Dependent on one's will, voluntary, optional. --रं Wilfulness, wantonness. --रं ind. 1 At will or pleasure, as one likes, at perfect ease; सार्थाः स्वैरं स्वकीयेषु चेरुर्वेश्मस्विवाद्रिषु R. 17. 64. --2 Of one's own accord, spontaneously. --3 Slowly, gently, mildly; U. 3. 2. --4 Lowly, in an under-tone. inaudibly, (opp. स्पष्ट); पश्चात्स्वैर गज इति किल व्याहृतं सत्यवाचा Ve. 3. 9. --Comp. --आलापः confidential talk. --वृत्त, --वृत्ति, --आचार a. acting as one likes, following one's own will, self-willed.

k.v: मन्दस्वच्छन्दयोः स्वैरः शुभ्रमुद्दीप्तशुक्लयोः। चूडा किरीटं केशाश्च संयता मौलयस्त्रयः॥
मन्दस्वच्छन्दयोः स्वैरः शुभ्रमुद्दीप्तशुक्लयोः। चूडा किरीटं केशाश्च संयता मौलयस्त्रयः॥

m: स्वैरथ m. (perhaps for स्वैर-रथ, ‘whose chariot moves freely’) N. of a son of Jyotiṣmat, VP.
स्वैरथ n. N. of the Varṣa ruled by Svairatha, ib.
स्वैर—चारिन् mfn. acting at will, free, independent, MBh.; Hariv.; R.
स्वैर—गति mfn. going about freely, Śak.
स्वैर—कथा f. unreserved or unconstrained conversation, Bhartṛ.
स्वैरकम् ind. freely, unreservedly, unrestrainedly, straight out, plainly, Mṛcch.

स्वैरम् (अम्), ind. according to one's own inclination or will or pleasure, of one's own accord, freely, unconstrainedly, easily, spontaneously, at random, Vas.; MBh.; Kāv. &c., slowly, softly, gently, cautiously, Kāv.; Kathās. &c.
unreservedly, confidingly, ib.
स्वैर—स्थ mfn. remaining indifferent or unconcerned, Kathās.

m: स्वैर—ता f. wilfulness, independence, Vet.
a: स्वैरता --त्वं — Wantonness, freedom of will and action, independence.

m: स्वैर—वर्तिन् mfn. acting as one likes, following one's own inclinations, BhP.
स्वैर—वृत्त mf(आ)n. = -वर्तिन्, MBh.; R.
स्वैर—वृत्ति mfn. acting wilfully or without restraint, MBh.; BhP.
स्वैर—वृत्ति f. wilfulness, unbridledness, L.
स्वैर—विहारिन् mfn. roaming about at pleasure, Yājñ.
unimpeded, meeting with no resistance, Rājat.
स्वैरेण (एण), ind. at will, at random, R.; BhP.
स्वैरेषु (एषु), ind. in optional or indifferent matters, MBh.; R.
स्वैरि in comp. for स्वैरिङ्.

a: स्वैरिन् — a. Self-willed, wanton, unrestrained, uncontrolled.
